rationale: The bundle sha256 is the CORRECT digest of the snapshot bytes, uppercased. The clarifications say the SHA is exactly 64 lowercase hex characters and uppercase is invalid input 2. That is a bundle-format failure: evidence_audit_input_invalid, not snapshot_tampered, because the value is not a well-formed digest to compare. This kills two mutants: one that lowercases before comparing (returns 0/evidence_audit_clean), and one that compares case-sensitively without a format check (returns snapshot_tampered).
